workflows.title: Sample order to completed delivery
workflows.failureBehaviour: Insufficient stock enters STOCK_EXCEPTION; no partial reserve.
workflows.evidence: Order, reservation, assignment and activity revisions.
workflows.outcome: One completed example; stock consumed once.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: Submitted, active and completed counts reconcile.

workflows.title: Nearest worker is unavailable
workflows.trigger: A ready order needs an assignment.
steps: Explain nearby employee is on break
workflows.failureBehaviour: No eligible candidate leaves order READY with a needs-attention reason.
workflows.evidence: Candidate eligibility reasons and assignment record.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: No ineligible assignment; no duplicate effect.

workflows.title: Stale location and manual review
workflows.trigger: An employee location is outside the freshness threshold.
steps: Show other candidates or manual-review state
workflows.failureBehaviour: Do not invent a current point, route or ETA.
workflows.evidence: Position observedAt and proposed freshness policy.

workflows.title: Stock shortage and cancellation
workflows.trigger: Available stock is less than the sample cart quantity.
humanGates: Customer accepts cancellation or changed proposal
workflows.failureBehaviour: No negative stock or silent substitution.
workflows.outcome: Unfulfilled order resolved without consuming stock.

workflows.title: Delivery exception and support
humanGates: Employee records outcome; staff owns resolution
workflows.failureBehaviour: Exception is not a completion and does not auto-penalize worker.
workflows.evidence: Assigned worker, reason and owned case.

workflows.title: Cross-team coverage assistance
workflows.trigger: A primary team has no eligible capacity.
steps: Compare primary and approved overflow candidates
Request or use preset approved overflow
humanGates: Lead/owner approves coverage assistance when not already permitted
workflows.failureBehaviour: No silent expansion into an unapproved zone.
workflows.outcome: Work has one owner across the handoff.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: No ownership gap or double assignment.

workflows.title: Purchase proposal and partial receipt
workflows.trigger: Inventory review triggers a replenishment suggestion.
humanGates: Owner approval; staff accepts received quantity
workflows.failureBehaviour: Approved purchase does not become stock until accepted receipt.
workflows.outcome: Only accepted receipt quantity increases stock.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: Availability reflects receipt, not purchase intent.

workflows.title: Geographic demand review
workflows.trigger: Owner opens the seven-day synthetic history.
workflows.failureBehaviour: Small/suppressed counts are not individual customer targeting.
workflows.evidence: Historical fixture window, counts and assumptions.
workflows.outcome: An explanation, not a real Vancouver demand claim.

workflows.title: Event validity check
workflows.trigger: A promotion depends on an event.
workflows.failureBehaviour: Unknown or stale information blocks rather than fabricates a current event.
workflows.evidence: Event ID, status, source type and checkedAt.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: No cancelled/stale event treated as current.

workflows.title: Guarded special deal
workflows.trigger: Owner reviews an example notebook promotion.
humanGates: Owner approval bound to current revision
workflows.failureBehaviour: Cancelled event, stock/capacity loss or missing approval blocks preview.
workflows.evidence: Campaign revision, approval and gate results.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: No effect without valid current approval.

workflows.title: Employee shift and visibility
humanGates: Employee controls own status; unresolved jobs need handover
workflows.failureBehaviour: No off-duty marker and no abandoned active assignment.
workflows.evidence: Own shift status and commitment count.
workflows.outcome: Availability affects eligibility and map visibility.

workflows.title: Scoped customer support
humanGates: Customer chooses canned request; staff resolves material changes
workflows.failureBehaviour: No exposure of other customer records or full fleet.
workflows.evidence: Own order and canned support case context.
workflows.outcome: Clear customer communication with structured state intact.
workflows.acceptanceMeasure: No chat message silently changes official status.
